Let your skills & strength shine Admin / HR / WHSE 
Bowhill Engineering is growing, and we're looking for capable, organised and proactive people to join our team to support Admin, HR & WHSE. 
You may come from an Administration background, have experience in Human Resources, be passionate about Workplace Health & Safety, or bring a combination of all three. What matters most is your ability to keep things organised, support our people, and help our business operate efficiently. 
We have opportunities across Administration, HR and WHSE functions, with responsibilities tailored to suit the skills and experience of the successful applicants. 
Whether you're looking to broaden your career, develop new skills, or bring your existing expertise into a supportive environment, we'd love to hear from you. 

About the Role 
In any of these roles, you'll become an important part of our team, providing administrative and operational support across a range of business functions. 

Depending on your experience and interests, your responsibilities may include: 
Administration Support 
-Reception and general office administration
-Calendar and appointment coordination
-Document preparation and record management
*Support the business wholistically with administration requirements
-Plan, prep and coordinate employee & visitor engagement activities & events 

Human Resources Support 
-Payroll processing assistance and backup
-Recruitment and onboarding coordination
-Employee records administration
-Performance appraisal coordination
-Employee recognition and wellbeing initiatives 

WHSE Support 
-Maintaining safety and compliance records
-Coordinating training and inductions
-Supporting audits, inspections and corrective actions
-Assisting with incident reporting and investigations
-Return-to-work and rehabilitation administration 
Full training and support will be provided, and the roles can evolve based on the successful candidate's strengths and career aspirations. 

What We're Looking For 
You don't need experience in all areas. We're interested in people who: 
? Are highly organised and detail-oriented 
? Enjoy helping others and supporting teams 
? Communicate professionally and confidently 
? Take initiative and ownership of their work 
? Can manage multiple priorities effectively 
? Have strong computer and administrative skills 
? Bring a positive, solutions-focused attitude 

Experience That Would Be Valuable 
-Business Administration
-Human Resources
-Payroll or Recruitment
-WHSE, Compliance or Training Administration
-Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) 

Relevant qualifications or a willingness to undertake further training will be highly regarded. 

Why Join Bowhill Engineering? 
At Bowhill Engineering, we're proud of the culture we've built. We're a team that values people, growth, accountability and continuous improvement. 

Employee Benefits Include: 
-Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
-Health & Wellbeing Support
-Reward & Recognition Programs
-Social Events & Team Activities
-Career Development & Training Opportunities
-Modern Workplace Facilities 
-Supportive Team Environment 

What You'll Love 
-Variety and flexibility in your role
-Opportunities to learn and develop new skills
-Making a genuine impact across the business
-Working with a team that values your contribution 

Ready to Apply? 
If you're an organised, motivated person looking for a rewarding role where you can make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Lead enterprise-wide AI, automation and digital transformation initiatives for a growing Adelaide organisation   
  Your New Company  
 Our client is a highly successful Australian organisation with a national footprint and a strong growth trajectory. Operating in a complex, fast-paced environment, the business is investing heavily in digital capability, automation, AI, and enterprise technology to drive operational excellence and commercial performance. 
 This newly created executive leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the future direction of the organisation by identifying, delivering, and embedding transformative technology initiatives that create measurable business outcomes. 
   
  Your New Role  
  Reporting to the executive leadership team, you will lead the organisation's digital transformation agenda, with a strong focus on delivering tangible commercial outcomes through AI, automation, systems integration, data, and technology-enabled change. 
   
 This is far more than a traditional IT leadership role. You will act as a strategic business transformation leader, identifying emerging technologies and translating them into practical opportunities that improve profitability, productivity, customer engagement, and operational performance. 
   
  Key responsibilities include:  
 
 
 Driving the organisation's digital transformation strategy and roadmap. 
 
 
 Delivering AI and automation initiatives with measurable ROI and business impact. 
 
 
 Leading large-scale enterprise programs across ERP, CRM, data, integration, reporting, and customer platforms. 
 
 
 Developing and presenting business cases to executive and board-level stakeholders. 
 
 
 Leading organisational change and ensuring successful adoption of new technologies and ways of working. 
 
 
 Providing strategic oversight of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure resilience, and technology governance. 
 
 
 Partnering with senior executives to identify new opportunities for innovation, efficiency, and growth. 
 
 
 Managing technology vendors, delivery partners, and internal technology teams. 
 
 
 Supporting acquisition and integration activities through scalable technology and data strategies. 
 
 
   
  What You'll Need to Succeed  
 To be successful in this role, you will bring a combination of commercial leadership, digital transformation expertise, and strong technical fluency.   
 You will demonstrate: 
 
 
 Proven experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives. 
 
 
 A track record of delivering AI and automation solutions into production with measurable commercial outcomes. 
 
 
 Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience developing and defending business cases with executive stakeholders. 
 
 
 Experience driving behavioural change and technology adoption across large and complex organisations. 
 
 
 Technical credibility across cloud platforms, systems integration, data architecture, cybersecurity, and enterprise applications. 
 
 
 Exceptional stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at both executive and operational levels. 
 
 
 Experience leading cross-functional technology, project, and business teams. 
 
 
 A genuine passion for emerging technologies and a demonstrated ability to stay at the forefront of industry trends. 
 
 
   
  What You'll Get in Return  
   
 In return, you will secure a rare opportunity to lead transformation at an enterprise scale and directly influence the future direction of a growing organisation. 
   
 You will enjoy: 
 
 A highly visible executive leadership position. 
 The opportunity to shape and execute a genuine digital transformation strategy. 
 Significant investment in technology, AI, automation, and innovation initiatives. 
 Direct exposure to executive and board-level decision-making. 
 The ability to deliver meaningful commercial outcomes and leave a lasting impact on the organisation. 
 A competitive executive remuneration package. 
 
   
  What to Do Next  
  If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, click 'Apply Now' to send your updated CV to  Bradley.lucas@hays.com.au  or call on 0872214159 for a confidential chat.  Please  click here  to apply.

policies for business and SMSF clients in accordance with Australian accounting and regulatory standards.   •    Preparing detailed financial reports, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, cash flow summaries, and year-end accounts for review by clients, directors, management, and relevant statutory authorities.   •    Reviewing client accounting records, undertaking audit support activities, preparing financial summaries and statutory reports, and providing factual information in relation to taxation obligations, entity structures, and business performance based on historical financial data.  •    Analysing client income, expenses, operating costs, and financial transactions to identify cost patterns, performance issues, and opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and compliance.   •    Checking the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of financial information and ensuring financial reports comply with relevant taxation, corporate, accounting, superannuation, and statutory obligations.   •    Providing practical tax-related guidance to individuals and businesses regarding business structures, operational planning, tax obligations, cash flow management, and long-term financial management.   •    Preparing income tax returns, Business Activity Statements, and related taxation documents for individuals, partnerships, companies, trusts, and other client entities, with final review and lodgement completed under the supervision of a registered Tax Agent.   •    Communicating with banks, lenders, finance providers, brokers, and external advisers to provide accounting information, liaise on client documentation requirements, and support compliance and reporting aspects of lending and funding arrangements.  •    Setting up, reviewing, improving, and maintaining accounting software and digital bookkeeping systems, including Xero and QuickBooks, while advising clients on effective record-keeping and system use.   •    Designing, implementing, and monitoring financial procedures, reconciliation processes, approval systems, and internal controls to support accuracy, accountability, and compliance across
